overview: Haiti covers the western third of the island of Hispaniola, which it shares with the Dominican Republic. Its capital and largest city is Port-au-Prince. In 1804 Haiti became the first country founded by formerly enslaved people, after a successful revolution against French rule, and the second independent country in the Americas. Haitian Creole and French are its official languages.

geography.text: Haiti is very mountainous; its name comes from a Taíno word meaning 'land of high mountains'. Two long peninsulas reach west on either side of the Gulf of Gonâve. Earthquakes and hurricanes have caused great damage, including a devastating earthquake in 2010.
